title: What's New in Filmora %1.
titleByManual: You are using the latest version. Check out the new %1 features!

features.name: Text to Video
features.discription: Unleash your creativity with Text to Video and experience the magic of Filmora AI

features.name: Image to Video
features.discription: Image to Video Now Powered by Veo 3! Experience Massively Enhanced Generation Results!

features.name: AI Idea to Video
features.discription: Transform your raw ideas into professional short videos while maintaining visual style consistency and ensuring character continuity across scenes.

features.name: AI Image Stylizer
features.discription: AI Image Stylizer Enhanced! Now available under the AIGC tab with expanded and enhanced image stylization capabilities.

features.name: Audio to Video
features.discription: Easily turn audio podcasts into captivating short videos. Edit, trim, and highlight your favorite stories.

features.name: Smart Short Clips
features.discription: Transform long videos into engaging shorts effortlessly. Cut, trim, and highlight your best moments!

features.name: Smart Scene Cut
features.discription: Effortlessly extract highlights and character scenes to boost editing efficiency.

features.name: Smart BGM Generation
features.discription: Automatically generate background music that matches your video's content and mood.

features.name: Auto Reframe
features.discription: Use Auto Reframe to export videos that match the aspect ratios of social media platforms.

features.name: AI Mate
features.discription: AI that understands, assists, and elevates. With AI Mate by your side, you can create stunning videos faster than ever before.

features.name: Multi-Camera Editing
features.discription: Import footage from multiple cameras and seamlessly switch between different angles for an efficient and convenient editing experience. Simplify complex editing processes and enhance your creative workflow.

features.name: AI Translation
features.discription: Automatically translate videos and audio into more than 20 languages, and sync audio with the speakers’ lip movements.
